title: Implesta for technical secondment and staffing
description: From client request to placed technician to approved hours and invoice, with every team informed along the way. Built for secondment firms.
teaser: Requests, matching, placements, approved hours and invoices in one flow.
h1: From client request to placed technician, without the chasing
lead: A client asks for two electromechanics on Monday. Sales logs it, operations sees who is free with the right skills, the client approves hours from a link, and finance invoices what was approved. Each team hears what it needs, when it happens.

items.title: The request that sits in a mailbox
items.text: Sales agreed a start date, and operations heard about it on Friday afternoon.

items.title: Matching from memory
items.text: Who has the certificate, the language and the free weeks? It lives in someone's head or a spreadsheet.

items.title: Hours the client disputes
items.text: The invoice is the first time the client sees the hours, and the discussion starts there.

signals.text: Every step in a placement tells the next one.

items.title: Prepare invoice: Packaging line commissioning

items.title: Planning and delivery
items.text: Skills, availability, pencilled-in and confirmed placements.

items.title: Time and approvals
items.text: Hours approved by your client from a link, before you invoice.
